The chemical formula of table salt is **NaCl** (sodium chloride).

Table salt is an ionic compound composed of sodium cations (Na⁺) and chloride anions (Cl⁻) in a 1:1 ratio. The sodium atoms each lose one electron, acquiring a positive charge, while the chlorine atoms each gain one electron, acquiring a negative charge. The oppositely charged ions then attract each other strongly, forming a crystal lattice structure.
